name: Saliency-Driven Adaptive Sampling
definition: A method to select an optimized subset from a dense point cloud that preserves global structure and critical details by dynamically adjusting retention probability based on comprehensive saliency scores.
summary: Saliency-Driven Adaptive Sampling selects an optimized point cloud subset for 3D Gaussian Splatting by using multi-modal geometric and color features to drive retention probability, preserving critical details better than uniform or spatial methods.
